title: Stop saying someday. Start your Travel Buddy plan.

dialogues.speaker: erin
dialogues.text: That trip you've been talking about? Make a plan. Find your people. Let's go.

dialogues.speaker: erin
dialogues.text: Open Travel Buddy in Tips to Trip. Create a post with your route, dates and the places you want to explore.

dialogues.speaker: erin
dialogues.text: Plan your days, add travel photos, and choose what matters to you in a travel buddy.

dialogues.speaker: erin
dialogues.text: Have a trip to share? Open its details and send the post to your friends.

dialogues.speaker: erin
dialogues.text: Manage your trips and review who wants to join. You choose who comes along.

dialogues.speaker: erin
dialogues.text: Then use your trip group chat to share ideas, ask questions, and bring everyone into the plan.

dialogues.speaker: erin
dialogues.text: From a trip idea to a group chat. Start your Travel Buddy post on Tips to Trip.
